Name: Senshi in Stardew (Dwarf or Linus Replacement)
Description:
Hello, this mod lets you change either Linus or the Dwarf into Senshi from Delicious in Dungeon! Well, visually at least. 
I was inspired to make this by Stinkyvicki's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23211]Delicious in Stardew[/url]﻿ monster recipes mod, I highly recommend checking it out!

The Dwarf option is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9642]The Last Smoluanu [/url]﻿mod, which you will need to use if you want to see the different emotions in the Dwarf portrait.


[b]Config options:

[/b]"Character_To_Replace": "Dwarf, Linus, Off"
[list]
[*] Choose which character to replace with Senshi or turn off the mod.
[/list]
"Dwarf_Emotions": "True, False",
[list]
[*] ﻿Turn off for static dwarf portrait. Turn on for dwarf portrait with emotions (requires compatible mod).
[/list]
"Change_Name": "True, False"
[list]
[*]Changes the chosen character's display name to Senshi if on.
[/list]

[b]Credits:[/b]
This mod was inspired by Stinkyvicki's Delicious in Stardew Mod.
Sprites were based on Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits mod.
Portraits were based on the original Linus portraits by ConcernedApe.
Dwarf Portrait emotions referenced from Miru36's Dwarf Portrait mod.
